use_cases.name: Simulate a leave policy change before publishing
use_cases.goal: Let HR simulate a proposed leave policy change against historical balances and requests and see the effect on balances, liability and coverage before publishing it.

stakeholders.interest: Knows the change in leave encashment liability before the policy goes live.
No balance is changed until the policy is approved and published.
Understands whether the change will reduce shop-floor coverage.

use_cases.trigger: HR drafts a change to a leave policy, for example raising earned-leave carry-forward from 30 to 45 days for band LS-STD.
preconditions: The leave ledger holds credits, debits, lapses and encashments for at least the previous leave year (RL-230).
Accrual policies are bound to leave bands (RL-170).
A sandbox copy of the policy can be edited without affecting the live version.
postconditions_success: A simulation report shows per-band and per-site balance change, liability change and coverage impact, and is attached to the policy change for approval.
postconditions_failure: The simulation is discarded or fails; live balances and the live policy are untouched.

main_flow.action: Copies the live accrual and carry-forward policy for LS-STD into a draft and edits the carry-forward cap to 45 days.
Chooses the replay window, leave year 2026, and the population: all LE-01 and LE-02 employees in band LS-STD.
Replays credits, requests and year-end lapse for the population under both live and draft policy in an isolated sandbox ledger.
Computes balance change per employee, band and site, and lapse days avoided.
Values the change in encashment liability at each employee's current daily rate, held as integer paise.
Estimates coverage impact from projected additional leave days per line and month.
Reviews the report and drills into sample employees to see their before and after ledger trail.
Attaches the simulation to the policy change and submits it for approval.
Approves publication with the simulation as evidence.

alternate_flows.condition: HR wants to try another value.
steps: HR edits the draft to 40 days and reruns; both scenarios are kept side by side.
The reason is recorded and the draft stays unpublished.

exception_flows.condition: Ledger history is incomplete for some employees, for example mid-year joiners from migration.
exception_flows.handling: Those employees are simulated from their opening balance and listed as partial-history in the report.

exception_flows.condition: A user without compensation scope runs the simulation.
exception_flows.handling: Liability values are withheld and only day counts are shown.

nfrs: Simulating one leave year for 5,000 employees completes in under 3 minutes.
No simulation step writes to the live leave ledger.

user_stories.want: to replay last year's leave under a draft policy
user_stories.so_that: I can show the impact of a change before asking for approval

acceptance.given: a draft raising LS-STD carry-forward from 30 to 45 days
acceptance.when: I simulate leave year 2026 for LE-01 and LE-02
acceptance.then: the report shows lapse days avoided and balance change per site

acceptance.when: I open E1043 Neha Mishra's sample
acceptance.then: I see her ledger trail under both the live and the draft policy

user_stories.want: the change in encashment liability valued in rupees
user_stories.so_that: I can provide for it before the policy goes live

acceptance.then: incremental liability is shown per entity and cost centre
the liability difference between them is stated

user_stories.want: to see whether a policy change will reduce coverage on my lines
user_stories.so_that: I can plan staffing before the change takes effect

acceptance.given: the draft adds an average of 1.5 leave days per worker per year at Peenya Works
acceptance.then: projected extra absence per line and month is shown

use_cases.name: Flag leave requests that breach team coverage
use_cases.goal: Let managers define minimum staffing per team or line and flag leave requests that would breach it at application time.

stakeholders.interest: Lines keep enough qualified people on every shift.
Knows at the time of applying whether a date is constrained and can choose another.
Fewer last-minute shortfalls that force overtime.

use_cases.trigger: A manager defines a coverage rule, or an employee applies for leave on a line governed by one.
preconditions: Line or team membership and rostered shifts are recorded for the period.
Approved and pending leave for the team is visible to the coverage check.
postconditions_success: Each leave request carries a coverage verdict; approvers see it, and breaching requests are approved only with a recorded reason.
postconditions_failure: If the coverage rule cannot be evaluated, the request proceeds with a stated warning and no silent approval.

main_flow.action: Defines minimum staffing for Peenya Machining shift A as 8 operators, with an effective date.
Applies for earned leave on 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21.
Runs leave rule validation, then counts rostered workers net of approved and pending leave for each requested date and shift.
Shows the employee that 2026-11-21 would leave 7 operators against a minimum of 8 and suggests nearby dates with headroom.
Submits the request anyway with a reason.
Starts the approval chain with the coverage verdict attached to the request.
Approves with a recorded coverage override reason or rejects with a reason.
Updates coverage for the dates and notifies Plant HR of any approved breach.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee changes dates to ones with headroom.
steps: The platform re-evaluates coverage and shows no breach.

alternate_flows.condition: Several requests are pending for the same date.
steps: Pending requests are counted in submission order and each is told its position.

exception_flows.condition: The roster for the requested period is not yet published.
exception_flows.handling: The verdict is 'coverage not evaluable' and the approver is told so.

exception_flows.condition: The approver tries to approve a breach without a reason.
exception_flows.handling: Approval is refused until a reason is entered.

nfrs: The coverage verdict is returned to the applicant in under 1 s at p95.
Coverage counts reflect leave approved up to the second before the check.

user_stories.want: to set a minimum number of operators per shift on my line
user_stories.so_that: leave approvals never leave a line short

acceptance.given: I set Peenya Machining shift A minimum to 8 from 2026-11-01
acceptance.when: 11 operators are rostered and 3 have approved leave on 2026-11-21
acceptance.then: a new request for that date is flagged as a breach

acceptance.when: I try to approve it without a reason
acceptance.then: approval is refused until I enter a reason

user_stories.want: to know at the time of applying whether my dates are constrained
user_stories.so_that: I can pick a date the line can spare me

acceptance.when: I select it in the leave form
acceptance.then: I see the coverage warning and 2026-11-24 suggested as having headroom

user_stories.want: notification of every approved coverage breach
user_stories.so_that: I can arrange cover before the shift

acceptance.given: a breach on Peenya Machining shift A on 2026-11-21 is approved
acceptance.then: I receive a notification naming the line, shift, date and shortfall of 1

acceptance.given: the roster for December is unpublished
acceptance.when: a request for December is submitted
acceptance.then: the verdict states coverage is not evaluable
